name: CamRestrictFlags
meaning: CamRestrict.flags (CameraRestriction+0x6a), built by init 0x4a1113 from the designer properties

name: CAMR_SNAPBETA
meaning: SNAPBETA: yaw snaps to multiples of 0x400 (same path as CAMREQ_SNAP_YAW)

name: CAMR_FORBIDPADCONTROL
meaning: FORBIDPADCONTROL: pad yaw input ignored (also implied by a trajectory)

name: CAMR_MIRRORBETA
meaning: MIRRORBETAINTERVAL: yaw is also allowed in the arc shifted by 0x800

name: CAMR_MODE_RUN
meaning: MISCFLAGS bit2: applies in camera mode 2

name: CAMR_MODE_FOLLOW
meaning: MISCFLAGS bit0: applies in modes 0 and 0xC; activates when the Wolf is inside an influence box

name: CAMR_MODE_ROBOT
meaning: MISCFLAGS bit1: applies in mode 6; activates when the Robot is inside an influence box

name: CAMR_NOTIFY_WOLF
meaning: MISCFLAGS bit3: on Wolf activation sends Wolf msg 0x425
